title: Goat Cheese Polenta with a Golden Beet Swirl
description: A spoonful of golden beet puree runs through soft goat cheese polenta, leaving ribbons of sweet beet in each serving.
equipment: Vitamix or immersion blender and tall jug

ingredients.name: plain cooked peeled golden beet
ingredients.note: Plain steamed beet, cubed and brought to room temperature.

steps.title: Blend the beet ribbon
steps.text: Blend {beet} with a splash of {milk} until smooth and spoonable, reserving the rest of the milk for the pan.

steps.title: Whisk the cornmeal
steps.text: Whisk {cornmeal} into {water} and the remaining milk in a cold saucepan until evenly dispersed.

steps.title: Cook the polenta
steps.text: Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly. Reduce the heat to low and cook partially covered for 20–28 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes until the grains are tender and the polenta falls softly from a spoon. Add a splash of water if it stiffens early.

steps.title: Melt in the cheese
steps.text: Remove the pan from the heat and stir in {cheese} and {thyme} until creamy.

steps.title: Swirl in the beet
steps.text: Spoon the beet puree into the hot polenta and fold just twice to leave golden ribbons. Warm over low heat for 1 minute before serving.

notes: Make ahead: Steam and puree the beet up to 2 days ahead and chill. For the clearest swirl, fold it into the polenta just before serving. Refrigerate in shallow portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. The swirl may blend together, but the polenta becomes creamy again when whisked with liquid. Freeze for up to 1 month. Fridge reheat: Loosen one portion with a splash of milk and whisk over medium-low heat for 5–8 minutes until creamy and at least 165°F. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight, then follow the fridge reheat instructions. For dairy-free polenta, use plain unsweetened oat milk and plain whipped dairy-free cream cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 177 kcal, 7.7 g protein, 28.5 g total carbohydrate, 4.1 g fat, 2.9 g fiber, 139 mg sodium.
